description: Intentional UNSAT — D=7, P=3, K=5. sum(cadence)=5 < sum(pillar_min)=7. Solver must return satisfiable=false. Mirrors channel-score-3 and swot-priorities-3 negative-test pattern.

Solver must detect and return satisfiable=false. The runner treats this as PASS because UNSAT is the expected outcome — mirrors channel-score-3 (budget too tight) and swot-priorities-3 (effort floor exceeds capacity) negative-test pattern.

This scenario verifies that the model correctly surfaces the infeasibility instead of returning a partial schedule.
